title: 104. Kth Largest Element in an Array

examples.explanation: Sorted descending: [6,5,4,3,2,1]. The 2nd largest element is 5.
Sorted descending: [6,5,5,4,3,3,2,2,1]. The 4th largest element (counting duplicates) is 4.

hints: A full sort works, but it does more ordering than the problem requires.
Keep a min-heap of the k largest values seen so far; its root is the answer.
Quickselect can achieve expected linear time by partitioning around a pivot.
